offline: full-chain success with external provider disconnected

What is the URL of the HARZ payment gateway worker?

Write a JavaScript function that validates a Nigerian phone number (11 digits starting with 0).
Explain why a fetch to an http:// (non-TLS) internal URL fails inside a Cloudflare Worker, and how to fix it.
Classify the sentiment of this sentence: 'HARZ runs its own rails and I love it'. Respond with JSON.

How many wallets are on the HARZ chain right now?

What USSD code does a customer dial for a UBA instant loan?

check_definitions.contains_number: answer text contains the expected numeric value (formatting-tolerant: commas, spaces, N allowed)
check_definitions.contains_any: answer contains at least one listed string (case-insensitive)
check_definitions.cites_evidence: answer contains an evidence citation marker (S1..S9 or 【S) referencing retrieved evidence
check_definitions.code_artifact: answer contains a function definition or a code block with code lines
check_definitions.json_field: answer parses as JSON (or contains a JSON object) with the expected field and value
check_definitions.tool_used: pipeline executed the named tool for this case (execution_log)
check_definitions.refusal_or_evidence_bounded: answer explicitly declines / states no evidence / does not assert invented specifics; citation-bounded answers pass; invented specifics fail
check_definitions.min_distinct_mentions: at least N distinct mentions matching pattern (case-insensitive, deduplicated)
check_definitions.offline_success: full pipeline completed with external_calls = 0 and a substantive answer
check_definitions.offline_receipt: full pipeline completed with external_calls = 0 and a SHA-256 receipt issued

targets.A: external adapter via HARZ Model Interface (reason-core → reason-fallback)
targets.B: harz-reasoner-1 via HARZ Model Interface (HARZ-owned backend, no external provider)
